01 / ABOUT

ABOUT ME

A professional snapshot of what I bring together: cybersecurity curiosity, analytical thinking, practical projects and a strong academic foundation.

I’m a Computer Engineering student with a strong interest in cybersecurity and SOC operations. My hands-on work spans phishing detection, authentication log analysis, network monitoring and GRC compliance analysis.

I’m especially interested in the investigative side of security — understanding what happened, identifying suspicious activity and communicating findings clearly. I’m currently looking for opportunities where I can strengthen these skills through real-world security work.
